mentions.name: Supabase security scanner
mentions.description: A security scanner for Supabase projects that includes proof-of-concept exploits and verification of findings before and after remediation, eliminating false positives. The author is offering free scans at launch.
mentions.problem: Security scanning tools produce false positives and lack proof-of-concept verification before and after remediation.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also launching a supabase security scanner. If someone wants a free scan hit me up. Includes POCs and verification before and after remidiation. Goodbye false positives.
